playground_shed_inspection.title: Sports shed
playground_shed_inspection.speaker: protagonist
playground_shed_inspection.text: A tin shed, its green paint faded at the edges. The padlock hangs open. Rain has got into the corner where the books are.
playground_shed_inspection.repeat_text: The shed is still half open. The books inside are still damp.

record.text: The playground shed is half open; rain has reached the books inside.

playground_wall_inspection.title: Notice wall
playground_wall_inspection.speaker: protagonist
playground_wall_inspection.text: Staples where notices used to be, plus the ones that stayed. The photo is crooked and no one has straightened it.
playground_wall_inspection.repeat_text: The crooked photo, the staples, the notices that stayed.

record.text: The playground notice wall holds old staples and a crooked class photo.

playground_equipment_inspection.title: Old equipment
playground_equipment_inspection.speaker: protagonist
playground_equipment_inspection.text: Two uprights, three crossbars, a ladder whose paint has worn to the metal underneath. The welds are different where the warm bar meets the post.
playground_equipment_inspection.repeat_text: The old frames, the worn paint, the different welds.

record.text: The playground equipment is old; the welds on the warm bar look different.

playground_ground.title: The ground
playground_ground.speaker: protagonist
playground_ground.text: Asphalt with a line painted around where a court used to be. The line goes under the wall and comes out the other side, as if the wall arrived later.
playground_ground.repeat_text: The court line, going under the wall.

record.text: A painted court line on the playground goes under the wall and reappears on the other side.

playground_fence.title: The fence
playground_fence.speaker: protagonist
playground_fence.text: Chain-link, leaning a little north. Beyond it: the backs of the same three blocks you came past, but their windows are dark.
playground_fence.repeat_text: The fence, the leaning, the dark windows beyond it.

record.text: Beyond the playground fence the same three blocks stand with dark windows.
